_comment: Declarative experiment matrix. Each entry becomes one swanctl connection on both alice and bob, named identically (conn == child name) so `swanctl --initiate --child <name>` is unambiguous. This file is the single source of truth for testbed config generation (testbed/scripts/gen_swanctl_conf.py) — see EXPERIMENT-REGISTER.md for which arms feed which experiment.

arms.name: cs-aes128gcm16
arms.note: AEAD, 128-bit key. Paired with cs-aes256gcm16 for the EXP-02 negative control.

arms.name: cs-aes256gcm16
arms.note: AEAD, 256-bit key. Identical structure to cs-aes128gcm16 except key length -> the negative control pair.

arms.name: cs-aes128ctr-sha256
arms.note: Counter mode, non-AEAD, 4-byte alignment like AEAD but 12-byte ICV like CBC — the interesting sieve case.

arms.name: cs-chacha20poly1305
arms.note: AEAD, shares (8,16,4) length signature with aes*gcm16 -> tests the stated F-04 indistinguishability limit.

arms.name: cs-transport-aes256gcm16
arms.note: Transport-mode arm for header-length-shift mode inference (A7 / EXP-06 adjacent).

arms.name: cs-pfs-off-aes256gcm16
arms.note: No DH group on the child SA -> PFS disabled on rekey. Baseline for EXP-03.

arms.name: cs-pfs-on-aes256gcm16
arms.note: DH group modp2048 on the child SA -> PFS enabled; CREATE_CHILD_SA rekey carries a KE payload. Compare rekey-message length against cs-pfs-off-aes256gcm16.
